frontmatter.description: Taiwan Logistics API integration specialist for ECPay, NewebPay, PAYUNi, SmilePay, PChomePay, PayNow and ezShip aggregators, HCT direct carrier API, and on-demand delivery (Lalamove, pandago, Uber Direct). Use when developing shipping flows, implementing CVS pickup (7-11/全家/萊爾富/OK), home delivery (黑貓/中華郵政), cold-chain, store-map selectors, COD orders, or shipment tracking. Handles encryption (MD5, AES-256-CBC, AES-256-GCM, 3DES), store maps, and provider field mappings.
